33:t_1:92.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Say hi to Mr. $$扇$$ too, while you're at it.」

33:t_1:94.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well, $$シンジ$$... we're off to school.」

33:t_1:104.en:
$$マコト$$
「All personnel, Condition One battle stations. Surface-to-air interception units, stand by!」

33:t_1:106.en:
$$シゲル$$
「It has breached the $$極東支部$$'s defensive line and will soon reach $$第３新東京市$$.」

33:t_1:107.en:
$$冬月$$
「So the enemy's target is here...」

33:t_1:110.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Unit-01's conversion to the Dummy Plug will be complete shortly.」

33:t_1:112.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
(The end of myth... Do they know what that means as well...?)

33:t_2:4.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unable to lock the plug in position! Dummy System connection signal rejected!」

33:t_2:6.en:
$$マヤ$$
「It's no good! The reset isn't working!」

33:t_2:7.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Continue. Start over again from 308.」

33:t_2:8.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Why...? Why do you reject me... $$ユイ$$!?」

33:t_2:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Let me... let me...! Let me pilot Unit-01!」

33:t_2:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Because I chose to... to fight in the EVA!」

33:t_2:15.en:
$$シンジ$$
「What I can do... is pilot the EVA... I... will use it to protect someone!」

33:t_2:16.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's... what I learned fighting with $c!」

33:t_2:18.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$ and $$真希波$$ are fighting with all they've got! I'll fight too!」

33:t_2:19.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I am... $$碇シンジ$$, pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$!」

33:t_3:6.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
(This is the only place I can live now.)

33:t_3:8.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
(It's all right, $$碇$$. Even if I disappear, I can be replaced.)

33:t_3:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「So I'm going to save you, right now!!」

33:t_4:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$!! Give me your hand!!」

33:t_5:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$... Thank you for what you did about Father...」

33:t_5:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Miss $$ミサト$$ told me. That dinner party... You'd invited Father too.」

33:t_5:6.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「I'm sorry. I couldn't do anything...」

33:t_5:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's all right now... This... is enough...」

33:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize. An emergency is unfolding, so $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will run on its automated system today.」

33:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Celebrations for ace pilots will also be postponed until next time.」

33:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good grief... Doomed to be caught in a $$時空震動$$... Bearing the $$烙印$$ is a hard life.」

34:t_000:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming!」

34:t_001:0.en:
$$マコト$$
「I never imagined they'd land in Japan and go straight for $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.」

34:t_001:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
($$ジェミニス$$ had its eye on this place too. Does $$サイデリアル$$ know what the EVAs mean...?)

34:t_001:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-00 is ready to launch. Unit-02's pilot also says she will sortie.」

34:t_002:0.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Can you both hear me? You can see the situation for yourselves.」

34:t_002:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「I didn't expect them to breach $$第３新東京市$$'s defenses so easily.」

34:t_002:3.en:
$$ミサト$$
「It's a relief you were here in the $$ジオフロント$$, $$マリ$$.」

34:t_002:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「...I had a bit of a bad feeling. So I dropped by $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ for the first time in ages, and here we are.」

34:t_002:8.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Be careful, both of you. $$サイデリアル$$ has sent in a battleship...」

34:t_002:9.en:
$$ミサト$$
「A battleship is the enemy unit's command center and affects the whole battlefield. I'd like to take it out early if possible, but...」
